title: Process-heavy host tests serialize every child spawn behind one launch lock, so outside load multiplies their run time (about 45x seen)
outcome: The turn-checks tests run in a bounded time under the shared machine's normal gate load, or the launch lock's cost under load is measured and the suite's behaviour under it is a documented, accepted limit.
acceptance: The inheritance-lock wait and hold time per spawn is measured quiet and under a concurrent full gate, and the cause of the slowdown is recorded with that evidence.
If the lock is the cause, the change that bounds the turn-checks module's run time under gate load keeps the handle-inheritance guarantee, and a test covers that guarantee.
